'''Philip Gilbert''' is credited on 6 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s as the source of the card image.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Set 13]], [[Virtual Set 15]], [[Virtual Set 18]], [[Virtual Set 22]] and [[Virtual Set 25]], sets dated 2020–2025 on this wiki. The credit on [[Young Skywalker|•Young Skywalker]] is shared with [[Card Credits#Francesco Accattatis|Francesco Accattatis]].
